theme: Blocking every line with half the moves
title: Pairing Guard on a Contested Board
mutation: composite: the Guard's reactive blocking policy is replaced by an explicit, budget-constrained PAIRING (involution) committed before play; the objective couples pairing-strategy-construction (which couples to commit to) with threat-counting (a fixed threat-ranked Aggressor plan the pairing must withstand) and a potential-function-bound flavor (a couple fully inside a line is a permanent certificate that line can never be lost, independent of play order) under a zone-distance pairing budget.
strategies: trivial: commit to the empty pairing (pure reactive lowest-index defense); reproduces the checker's own baseline B
greedy: sort lines by weight descending, for each still-pairable line commit its cheapest-cost still-free internal couple if the budget allows; myopic per-line packing

strong: build every candidate couple's TOTAL cross-line coverage (sum of weights of all not-yet-covered lines that contain both its cells), repeatedly commit the highest-coverage affordable couple -- this recognizes and exploits shared hub couples that certify several winning lines at once
invalid: commits the same cell to two different pairs (infeasible, must score 0)
